provenance: Real English Dify UI: October11 signed Marketplace installation and completed generation result replace earlier development preview. Key screenshots and configuration panels retain their recorded October9 source. No UI status was fabricated; screenshots only cropped.

key_source.privacy: Balance, application ID and complete/partial token are opaque-masked before screenshot capture. Dialog crops omit unrelated UI.
key_source.edits: Crop + numbered callouts on live screenshot only; no UI data or success state fabricated.
key_source.capture_actions: Read application page, open Manage Keys, open Create, fill example name, cancel; no credential created and no billable API call.

instructions.1: Copy the selected existing key. The screenshot redacts it. Paste only token in Dify, not the Bearer label.
instructions.2: Manage Keys, then Create; use own key name and appropriate restrictions. Return to the list/application page to copy.

key_source.published_screenshot_language: English only in every locale, per explicit user instruction
